text:
Nora Patel: Quick roundup 0-- drafting a concise DP run to validate Private onboarding friction + Dedicated commit signals. Proposal: 6 partners, staggered starts over 2 weeks, 21-45 day pilots depending on integration.

Diego Ramos: +1. Target mix: 2 regulated (fin/health), 2 SaaS, 1 ecommerce infra, 1 embeddings-first startup.

Hana Lee: Keep screener light: 1) use case & compliance 2) steady QPS + peak 3) start window 4) willing to share small eval set? Two lines max.

Will O'Connor: SLOs suggestion: gen p50 < 75ms, p95 < 280ms @256 tokens. embed p50 < 25ms, p95 < 65ms. Separate buckets called out in outreach.

Nora Patel: Success gates per partner: A) E2E integration + smoke tests B) Perf SLOs met in replay run C) Security checklist clear (KMS/audit logs) D) Feedback engagement >= 6 labeled cases with repros.

Diego Ramos: Define a "labeled case": prompt family + expected behavior + severity + triage ticket. Partners should submit 6 families of 8-10 examples.

Hana Lee: Ops asks: we'll provide replay harness + token-sensor script and a small Prom endpoint for metrics. Partners must run smoke tests 48-72h in staging.

Will O'Connor: Incentives: 2 months discounted Dedicated credits + up to 5 dev days + co-marketing for strategic partners.

legal-bot: Add anonymized metrics consent and safe-harbor clause. NDA + DP addendum required; share templates in #legal-dp.

ops-bot: NOTE: Limited SLA allowed for reserved windows (99.8%). Maintenance windows Tue/Wed 02:00-04:00 PT. Ops will cap concurrent stress tests.

Nora Patel: Feedback cadence: weekly async notes, mid-pilot 60m review, final deep-dive. Post-pilot monthly check-ins x3. We'll require partners join invite-only triage channel.

Diego Ramos: Measurement KPIs to capture: days-to-first-successful-call (target <=7), eng FTE-days (target <=5), time-to-triage (target <=48h), feedback items submitted.

Hana Lee: For large enterprise, accept up to 45-day pilots; trade-offs logged: extra eng time vs longer pilot. Use a trade-log spreadsheet with approvals.

Nora Patel: Action items: @Hana finalize screener + outreach copy by EOD Thu; @Diego publish eval template + sample CSV; @Will prep replay how-to & smoke scripts; @Legal sign-off on DP addendum. I'll shortlist prospects and send invites Friday.

dp-bot: COHORT CREATED dp-priv-cohort-2025-11. Calendar kickoff placeholder 2025-11-11 09:00 PT.

Will O'Connor: Outreach draft will be in #product/outreach by 1500 PT tomorrow.

Nora Patel: Thanks team 1 — ping me if you want to join Fri invite review (08:30 PT).

dp-bot: Reminder scheduled: DP kickoff 2025-11-11 09:00 PT (tentative).
